decisions.reason: GA4 remains the relevant analytics standard for online shops, so this plugin still fits the firm's core service stack and is worth keeping given likely modest maintenance costs.
Universal Analytics is obsolete, so the downside is essentially resolved and management would reallocate the small remaining effort to more current offerings.

The retail system interface plugin matches the firm's integration capabilities and may still create cross-selling and client-retention value, so the option would likely be kept open while demand remains somewhat uncertain.
SEO support for shop relaunches is tightly connected to the firm's established full-service e-commerce work and is inexpensive to continue offering.
SEO workshops are a newer and more uncertain offer, but they leverage existing expertise at low cost, so management would likely continue them for another year to learn more about market uptake.
